rules: R1: apps/web is a static SPA (React 18 + Vite). No SSR, no Next.js patterns.
R2: Secrets never touch the client. Anything without a VITE_PUBLIC_ prefix must never be referenced under apps/web/src; it belongs in apps/api or a GitHub Actions job script.
R3: One types source. Every shared interface/DTO/zod schema lives in packages/types — never redefined inline in either app.
